# Trading Command Suite

**Status:** active
**Category:** E (product / user)
**Created:** 2026-10-31
**Last updated:** 2026-10-31
**Owner:** TCS team

<!-- Source for the published wiki Home page. Generated by scripts/publish-public-docs.cjs — edit here.
     The wiki page was created by hand to bootstrap the wiki, and it stayed empty because nothing owned
     it. It has a source file now, so it is published like every other page. -->

An open-source, **self-hosted** algorithmic trading platform: a scoring engine built from small named
rules, a gating pipeline that has to be satisfied before anything trades, an automation loop, and an
audit chain that can answer *"why did it buy that?"* for every order.

> 🛑 **Before you connect an account — [read the financial disclaimer](Financial-Disclaimer).**
> This software is **not configured to profit by default**, no strategy it ships has been shown to be
> profitable, and it is pre-release. **Use a demo account.**

---

## What is unusual about it

**A decision trail, per trade.** Every order can be traced back through the gate that allowed it, the
score that produced it, and the directive that moved the score. Most retail systems cannot answer why
they bought something — this one records it as a first-class object.

**"Cannot judge" is a real answer.** An empty list, a failed query and a genuine zero are three
different things, and the app renders them differently. Plausible output with no error is the defect
class that costs money, so the app is built to refuse rather than guess.

**Honest about what is unproven.** There is no performance claim anywhere in this project, and the
scoring is described as an opinion computed from data rather than a prediction.

## Scale, stated as floors

The analysis layer is a library of **more than 100 named directives** — small single-purpose rules,
each with its own weight — grouped into **more than 40 protocols**.

⚠️ Deliberately floors, not exact counts: they are rounded *down* so they stay true as the platform
grows and never need chasing. The exact figures are generated and build-checked in
[`docs/GENERATED-FACTS.md`](https://github.com/FifeCIC/Trading-Command-Suite/blob/master/docs/GENERATED-FACTS.md).
